# discord_sticker_packs (Data Source)

Lists Discord's standard sticker packs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_sticker_packs" "all" {}

output "sticker_pack_names" {
  value = data.discord_sticker_packs.all.packs[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `packs` (Attributes List) Sticker packs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packs))

<a id="nestedatt--packs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packs`

Read-Only:

- `banner_asset_id` (String) ID of the pack's banner image.
- `cover_sticker_id` (String) ID of the sticker shown as the pack's icon.
- `description` (String) Pack description.
- `id` (String) Pack ID.
- `name` (String) Pack name.
- `sku_id` (String) ID of the pack's SKU.
- `stickers` (Attributes List) Stickers in the pack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packs--stickers))

<a id="nestedatt--packs--stickers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packs.stickers`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Sticker description.
- `format_type` (String) Format: `png`, `apng`, `lottie`, `gif`.
- `id` (String) Sticker ID.
- `name` (String) Sticker name.
- `sort_value` (Number) Sort order within the pack.
- `tags` (String) Autocomplete and suggestion tags.
